name: WebHook
description: Send alerts to a custom webhook.

USE_WEBHOOK.help: Enable sending alerts to a custom webhook.
USE_WEBHOOK.label: Use webhook

WEBHOOK_HTTP_HEADERS.help: Extra HTTP headers to send with the webhook request, one "Name: value" per line (e.g. an Authorization token or a shared secret). Leave empty for none.
WEBHOOK_HTTP_HEADERS.label: Extra HTTP headers

WEBHOOK_RETRY_IF_LIMITED.help: Retry to send the request if the remote server is rate limiting us (may consume a lot of resources).
WEBHOOK_RETRY_IF_LIMITED.label: Retry if limited by webhook

WEBHOOK_ALERT_IPS.help: Only notify denied requests from these IPs/networks (separated with spaces). Leave empty to notify every denied request.
WEBHOOK_ALERT_IPS.label: Alert IPs

WEBHOOK_UNLISTED_THRESHOLD.help: When WEBHOOK_ALERT_IPS is set, send one notification for each IP not in the list that is denied this many times within WEBHOOK_UNLISTED_PERIOD (0 to disable).
WEBHOOK_UNLISTED_THRESHOLD.label: Unlisted IPs threshold

WEBHOOK_UNLISTED_PERIOD.help: Period in seconds used to count denied requests per IP not in WEBHOOK_ALERT_IPS.
WEBHOOK_UNLISTED_PERIOD.label: Unlisted IPs period

WEBHOOK_BAN_ALERT.help: When WEBHOOK_ALERT_IPS is set, send one escalated notification when a watched IP gets banned (added to the ban list), and mute the per-request block alerts for it while the ban lasts.
WEBHOOK_BAN_ALERT.label: Alert on watched IP ban

WEBHOOK_BAN_MENTION.help: Optional mention prepended to the ban notification only (e.g. left empty for a generic webhook). Leave empty to disable.
WEBHOOK_BAN_MENTION.label: Ban alert mention

WEBHOOK_FORMAT.help: Message format: 'default' (built-in text payload), 'structured' (predefined field-based JSON) or 'template' (custom, uses WEBHOOK_TEMPLATE).
WEBHOOK_FORMAT.label: Message format

WEBHOOK_TEMPLATE.help: Custom notification payload (raw JSON) used when WEBHOOK_FORMAT=template. Supports {{variables}} and {{#if var}}...{{/if}} sections; values are JSON-escaped and the result must be valid JSON (falls back to default if not).
WEBHOOK_TEMPLATE.label: Custom template
